digest.component_or_area: test safety linting / shell script validation
propositions: A pytest test subprocess-execs a shell script with unguarded destructive deletion (rm -rf against an interpolated variable that can expand to empty or root), destroying host filesystem content

Static analysis gate must flag test patterns that perform rm -rf on interpolated variables without safe guards, but pass tests using injectable seams (${RM_CMD:-rm}) or explicit guards (${dir:?} with deny-list)
Gate must report path:line for each finding, exit non-zero, and integrate into make lint (pre-commit hook and CI), matching output shape of existing linting gates
set -euo pipefail alone does not prevent the vulnerability because set -u fires only on unset variables, not on variables set to empty string
